prompt: What is the canonical churn rate as of 2026-09-30, split by region?
answer_text:
2 row(s).
Assumption: Used the canonical churn_rate: customers with no revenue order in the last 90 days (is_churned) divided by customers who have ordered (has_ordered), as of 2026-09-30.
Assumption: Region is taken from region_code in rpt_customer_churn.
Assumption: Not using marketing's legacy 180-day definition (is_churned_marketing).
Note (cav_as_of_date): Recency, churn, activity and tenure are measured against the as_of_date var (2026-09-30), the last day of loaded data, not today's date.
Note (cav_two_churn_definitions): There are two churn definitions. Customer Insights' churn_rate (canonical) is 90 days without an order, among customers who have ordered. Tables: rpt_customer_churn

sql: select region_code, cast(sum(case when is_churned then 1 else 0 end) as numeric) / nullif(sum(case when has_ordered then 1 else 0 end), 0) as churn_rate from marts.rpt_customer_churn group by region_code order by region_code
